profile.headline: Software Engineer (Google DeepMind Robotics)
profile.summary:
Accomplished Service Engineer with over 14 years of extensive experience comprised of delivering strong results, providing excellent customer service, and possessing a deep understanding of customer and business needs. Effective leader who designs and executes big-picture strategies that satisfy critical business goals through creating innovative, cost-efficient, and end-to-end solutions. Constantly searching for ways to improve the status quo via technology, automation, and methodology. Strong business sense with an insatiable hunger to learn, innovate, inspire and contribute.

•	Experienced in building, developing and leading efficient technical teams, managing lab infrastructure, and running operations.

•	Skilled in comprehensive troubleshooting of large scaled systems for code, network, operating system and storage. 

•	Comprehensive project management skills working with cross-functional teams, staying on-budget, capacity planning, expanding team's abilities, and improving resource capabilities.

•	Accurately assess and prioritize tasks to match dynamic business needs in high-pressure environments.

positions.title: System Engineering Manager
positions.description:
·	Formulated and orchestrated an ad-hoc testing team, which reduced testing time by over 70% to meet 3 week sprint deliverables.
·	Grew and developed a dynamic team of 10 to handle day to day lab operations, assisting R&D in running tests, and helping individual developers in setting up new devices.
·	Developed an entirely new system and application health monitoring tool using VBScript, C#, ASP, and SQL to track and report per global R&D development and testing needs.
·	Instituted and oversaw a global R&D inventory tracking system that improved throughput by 30%, as well as, optimized better sharing of existing assets among various groups.
·	Spearheaded a multi-year technical move project (physical and logistical) post Ericsson acquisition.  Successfully achieved planned near-zero downtime for all services globally.
·	Custom designed and built 20K square feet of new next generation R&D labs to accommodate business needs of all R&D groups.
·	Conducted monthly budget and capacity planning to support R&D for rapid changes to meet urgent customer demands.

positions.title: System Engineering Manager
positions.description:
·	Reduced reproduction time of customer reported bugs by 85%, from 1 week to less than 24 hours.
·	Engineered a ticketing system to handle and standardized all R&D support requests, which provided a simple interface to submit, manage, track, and receive automatic updates.
·	Experienced multiple hardware components failures on primary reporting server when the monitoring service was scaled out too quickly. Instead of upgrading hardware components, a time splicing solution was implemented to reduce future run-away hardware costs. 
·	Instituted monthly training sessions to increase team’s abilities in order to handle the constant influx of new hardware types and technologies with limited allowed headcount.
·	Simulated network isolation normally provided by residential gateways through converting MTBF lab’s flat network to 96 dedicated VLANs in order to support concurrent testing of over 1000 set top boxes.

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
·	Designed and built a lightweight continuous monitoring engine using VBS to assess all R&D environments in near real-time. This engine became the baseline for each test iteration used by testers as it was capable of quickly troubleshooting constant code and configuration changes.
·	Owned and launched an internal reporting site to display R&D environments' current status with customizable search parameters leading to a 50% reduction in user wait and response time.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test (contractor)
positions.description:
·	Reduced 75% of installation time by automating daily installs of new builds on multiple environments and eliminated manual configuration errors by 100%.
·	Created a 24/7 continuous AV scanner system and verification process that saved over 8 man hours per day and reduced the number of investigations for overnight test case failures.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
·	Ensured a 99.995% uptime on 180 real-time financial data serving production servers with only a team of three and being on-call 24/7.
·	Audited and optimized power consumption of production servers to decrease running cost by over $14,000 annually, while ensuring full power redundancy to mitigate failures.

positions.title: System Administrator
positions.description:
·	Ensured a 99.995% uptime on 180 real-time financial data serving production servers with only a team of three and being on-call 24/7.
·	Audited and optimized power consumption of production servers to decrease running cost by over $14,000 annually, while ensuring full power redundancy to mitigate failures.

positions.title: Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
·	Redesigned customer management system to include technical support ability by standardizing input methodology, sharing interaction history with the team, and generating detailed reports for upper management.
·	Served as lead escalation engineer to troubleshoot high priority issues, handle difficult customers, and liaison between developers and customers during testing of upcoming features.
